note: The operator publishes no street address anywhere on this page. The only location it gives is "Mornington Peninsula, Victoria 3936", and the record carries 3937. That is not enough to say where Birch Creek is and it is enough to say the record is unconfirmed by its own operator. Filed as a dispute rather than left unevidenced on purpose: "somebody looked and the operator disagreed" and "nobody has looked" are different facts, and the registry is supposed to be able to tell them apart.
